ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR45] Requires NextStep at the moment of moving Qualification->Solutioning or Solutioning->Negotiation, for Medium/High Touch deals only. Per IRM correction, this is transition-specific (not a static stage check) and does not...
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity' ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Renewal') ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, 'Medium Touch'), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, 'High Touch') ),
OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Qualification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning') ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation') ) ),
ISBLANK(NextStep) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Next Step is required to advance to the next stage. Please enter the next steps.
